subject: Archaeology
subcategory: Lost Cities of the Ancient World
title: The Hunt for Atlantis
description: One-minute skill: The Hunt for Atlantis.

hook.text: Plato described Atlantis as a powerful island that sank in a single day. People have been looking ever since.

buildup.text: Over 11,000 books and articles have been written about Atlantis. Proposed locations span every continent.

discovery.text: Most scholars believe Plato invented Atlantis as a parable about the dangers of pride and imperial ambition.

twist.text: Some archaeologists point to the Minoan eruption of Santorini as the real event behind the fictional story.

climax.text: Despite zero archaeological evidence, Atlantis remains the most searched-for lost city in history.

punchline.text: The most famous lost city probably never existed. We keep looking anyway.

quiz.question: What do most scholars believe about Plato's Atlantis?
options: It was a real city destroyed by a volcanic eruption
He invented it as a parable about pride and imperial ambition
It was a coded description of ancient Egypt
